svg.title: Cassette/radio Bluetooth conversion with ESP32 schematic
svg.desc: Black-on-white schematic. Cassette tape head and antenna feed a preamp and TA2003PG radio; both sum through tone and volume pots into an AN7141 amp driving a mono speaker. An ESP32 Bluetooth board injects audio from DAC1 through a 4u7 cap and 10k resistor into the volume-pot input. The play switch is shorted so the motor transistor is always on, feeding 6V to the ESP32 VIN. Three GPIO buttons (prev, next, pairmode) tie to ground with internal pull-ups.
